The '''Ambush at Kestavel''' was an event that took place several months after the [[Declaration of a New Order|creation]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], which nearly resulted in the assassination of the Empire's primary enforcer, [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]].

==Prelude==
The [[Assassin/Legends|assassination]] attempt on [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Vader]] had been planned for at least several weeks beforehand, with [[Dass Jennir]] reluctantly carrying out the plot, having just settled for a comfortable life. However, the ambush nearly [[Duel on Kestavel|ended]] before it could begin due to distrust among Jennir's allies about keeping secrets from each other, as well as the machinations of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]]-turned [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] agent, [[Beyghor Sahdett]]. Afterwards, the ''[[Uhumele]]''{{'s}} captain, [[Schurk-Heren]] revealed to [[Bomo Greenbark]] that he managed to pick up a large supply of explosives, an idea he had come up with since Greenbark [[Skirmish on Mimban|saved the group]] on [[Mimban/Legends|Mimban]]. In addition, they also planned on allowing the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperials]] to cross over to the second bridge before ambushing them, due to the bridges being a chokepoint alongside the archway tunnel preceding the casino, as well as coming up with a strategy to cull the Imperial forces.

==The ambush==
Eventually, holed up inside [[Kestavel]]'s local [[Hotel/Legends|hotel]], [[The Lucky Twi'lek]], Greenbark, [[Kai Hudorra]], and Jennir waited out for Vader's arrival, having earlier flooded the main entrance with enough engine fuel to cover the bridge when released. When Greenbark sighted Vader arriving via the second gate, Jennir told Greenbark to leave him, also ordering him to flee to the canyons until it is safe, then upon arriving at the ''Uhumele'', tell Captain Heren not to spare the engines when leaving. Huddora then witnessed the arrival of Vader's forces, as well as their disarming the explosives under the second arch under Vader's command, privately remarking that he expected Vader to bypass that particular trap. Vader, likewise, sensed both Jennir and Huddora inside the hotel, and deduced that the former made an ally. Jennir then opened the impromptu floodgates and released the engine fuel. Vader then jumped up to the gate's wall as the engine fuel covered his stormtrooper troops. Immediately after they informed Vader of what the fluid was, also citing they should retreat until the fuel evaporated and forbidding anyone to fire their weapons, they saw a spark thrown out of a window to the flooded bridge.

Elsewhere, on the surface of the [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Venator''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Hound (Star Destroyer)|''Hound'']], [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Gregg]] got into an argument with the other Imperial officers on standby, as Vader had ordered them to not interfere on his behalf, with Gregg also pulling his [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] on one of the officers to ensure the order was followed, before he witnessed from afar a blaze at the location of The Lucky Twi'Lek. A communication popping up shortly thereafter stated that all communications were lost. This led Gregg to believe Vader to have been [[Death/Legends|killed]]. In actuality, Vader narrowly evaded the fire, resulting in his cape being singed.

Vader entered The Lucky Twi'lek, finding only Hudorra waiting for him. The two dueled until the Bothan Jedi Master attempted to activate a [[Thermal detonator/Legends|thermal detonator]], which would trap them under the rubble if not kill them outright. Vader used [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] to stop Hudorra, stunning him momentarily and giving him the chance [[Cho mai/Legends|sever]] his hand. After attempting to interrogate Hudorra, who would reveal nothing about Jennir, Vader killed him. Vader then followed the Force signature of whom he thought was Jennir, only to discover Sahdett bound and gagged. After questioning his presence, he [[Sai cha/Legends|decapitated]] the [[Verpine/Legends|Verpine]] in anger.

Bomo then arrived at the ''Uhumele'', and boarded inside with the [[Shaylai Veila|two]] [[Kal (bodyguard)|remaining]] crew to board, hastening the boarding before being spotted by [[Vapor|mist creatures]]. The ''Uhumele'' managed to escape into space. Jennir also ended up unwittingly escaping, due to Hudorra drugging his drink earlier.
